entry.author: New Zealand Story
entry.summary: 🌏 New Zealand is setting the standard in innovative and technical outdoor gear! @kathmandu  is at the forefront, showcasing how to blend cutting-edge technology with a deep commitment to sustainability and ethical practices. By focusing on reducing environmental impacts and promoting human welfare, Kathmandu is proving that you can create high-quality, innovative outdoor gear while caring for the planet and its people.
